summary: Transaction 3441648 ($49.91) on card C09530-K1 was flagged by monitoring due to a high second-generation model score of 0.992 despite a low legacy risk score. The transaction was an online purchase for product category H, which departs sharply from the cardholder's established history of 149 in-person purchases in product category W and occurred just 1.5 hours after an in-person charge in region 272. Knowledge graph analysis linked the operating device D003615 to three other cards experiencing identical ~$50 online charges within a 7-day window, as well as twelve confirmed fraud closed cases. The activity was confirmed as card-not-present fraud with 0.97 probability. Card C09530-K1 was blocked, connected cards were placed under monitoring, and a SAR filing was initiated.
